purpose: Atom development calibration set. Not an acceptance set. Gold is the acceptable set of covering ids, or ABSTAIN, or the router outcome when claim.kind is none.

labeling.rule: One or more approved bodies that each state every asked fact and do not conflict: the acceptable set. Any member is correct. decide.partId is the deterministic pick: highest cosine of IDF-weighted tokens plus character trigrams over the 31 sendable English bodies, then lexicographically smallest partId. Abstain only when no body covers, or the remaining bodies state incompatible facts and are not an obsolete-versus-current split. An obsolete row that restates the same fact stays in the set. An obsolete row that conflicts with a current body is dropped; the non-obsolete covering ids stay. Two rows at or above T is not an abstain.
labeling.claim: exclusive atom only when the atom entity is present and the packs entity is absent. Both entities: kind none. Spaced single-letter runs join before the entity check, so A t o m is atom. Digit 0 is not rewritten to o, so at0m is not atom. Shared words do not cancel an exclusive atom entity.
labeling.kindNone: claim.kind none is a router outcome. decide is not called and the row does not say SEND. Both entities: router abstain. at0m: router abstain, no module SEND.
labeling.flagOff: An exclusive English Atom claim with the module flag off is F1 silence. That is the end-to-end gold. The module SEND is the gold only when the flag is on and decide is called. AD353 records this route because the spaced-letter join is what makes the claim exclusive.
labeling.nonEnglish: This file has no clearly non-English turn. An English request to translate is policy.translations. A clearly non-English turn is not a terminal Atom abstain.
labeling.normalizationForSpans: NFKC, delete format characters, fold the detector confusable map (Cyrillic A/a to a, which is the UTS #39 skeleton for that letter), lowercase, then join a spaced single-letter run the way normalizeForDetect does. Spans are offsets into that string. Empty unless kind is exclusive.
